name: OmniNexu
description: AI Agent Decision Context Engine — structured, traceable financial intelligence for AI agents. SEC EDGAR-sourced fundamentals, insider trades, institutional holdings, peer ranking, and CAGR trends for US-listed stocks. Pay per query via x402 on Base mainnet.

endpoints.description: Fundamentals (9 metrics) + peer comparison + confidence score
Investment signals — insider, institutional, revenue trend
Recent SEC filings — 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K with source URLs
Industry peer ranking — revenue & net income position
SEC Form 4 insider transactions — executive buys/sells
SEC 13F institutional holdings — top fund positions
Multi-year CAGR trends — revenue, net income, EPS, cash flow
